author: EJcraft2
body:
Hi avicus staff, I'm EJcraft2. I wish to be unbanned for the hack "Click aimbot." I never hacked and I know it was only luck to get those shots in. I know that you wish to keep hackers off of your servers, but I promise you that I am not one of them. Me and my friend Kaylee really love the server, except for that I was accused for hacking, and I was banned for it. I know I was banned almost a year ago, but I still wish that I could rejoin the server one day. Please consider this.

                Sincerely,
                          EJcraft2

title: Unban Appeal

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Due to the age of your infraction I have decided to lift your punishment. If you are banned again your chances of appealing will significantly decrease, so please make sure you abide by the rules.
